title: Shelter: one usable enclosure near camp
applies_when: The camp needs its first enclosed room.
approach: Use nearby explored ruins or a hill face when they reduce wall work. Choose the entrance and complete perimeter before placing furniture.
Keep beds, storage and a clear walking route inside the enclosure. Prefer a small complete room over several unfinished rooms.

Where timber is plentiful, wooden walls are a quick start. Reserve scarce steel for equipment; use available stone blocks when their extra labor is affordable. These are material preferences, not required def names.
Validate every wall, door and roof cell against live geometry. Never infer a room from an arbitrary room ID or use unexplored cave space.
verify: The finished space is enclosed, roofed, reachable and near the chosen camp.
reconsider: The observed footprint cannot fit the furniture or the site requires excessive mining.
